## Description

Applies diffusion maps (spectral embedding) to high-dimensional asset return time series to discover non-linear low-dimensional intrinsic price manifolds, trading mean-reversion on diffusion distance residuals.

## Where it may fit

Non-linear cross-asset relationships, equity sector co-movement during macro turbulence, high-dimensional relative value trading.

## Vehicles

Statistical arbitrage hedge funds, quantitative market-neutral equity desks.

## Required data

High-frequency or daily return matrices across broad equity/ETFs, Gaussian kernel bandwidth parameters.

## Caveats

Diffusion operator kernel matrix construction scales quadratically with asset universe dimension.
